name: Hello
author: brodgar
description: Example addon — demonstrates the event bus, timers, saved variables (hafen.store), and the read API (hafen.gob.*, hafen.world.*, hafen.map.*, hafen.player.* incl. vitals, hafen.time.*, hafen.sound.*, hafen.items.*, hafen.char.* incl. food/skills, hafen.party.*, hafen.buffs.*, hafen.study.*, hafen.actionbar.*) plus the widget-tree events (VitalsChanged, BuffAdded/Removed/Changed, FepChanged, StudyChanged, ActionbarChanged, EquipChanged).
